label_policy.quote_policy: exact_quote is copied verbatim from annotation_inventory.comment_segments and excludes nonplacement segments
label_policy.target_policy: An explicit version reference or a single displayed output yields exactly one target label. Unspecified pairwise comments retain the single comparison_set marker and are not duplicated across variants.
label_policy.interpretation_policy: expected_issue_codes and acceptable_components are agent mappings to the runtime contract; they are not human-authored labels.
label_policy.negative_label_policy: No severity, pass/fail, or absence-of-defect label is inferred. Selected rows without direct placement evidence are excluded.
